en.name: Witcher
en.ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a player: they die, and the Demon can't attack tonight. If you kill the Demon, you & they swap characters & alignments.

zh.name: 猎魔人
zh.ability: 每局游戏限一次，在夜晚时*，你可以选择一名玩家：他死亡，且当晚恶魔不能攻击。如果你杀死了恶魔，你和他交换角色和阵营。
